caption: The drawing depicts a four-story building with a slanted roof and a tall rectangular chimney rising from the back left corner. The building is rendered in muted brown and beige tones, with the walls appearing tan and the edges outlined in a darker shade. The front side shows six evenly spaced vertical rows of tall rectangular windows, framed with reddish-brown sills, and the uppermost row of windows has rounded tops. The left side of the building displays additional windows of the same style, and the ground floor features large blue-tinted glass display windows, suggesting a commercial space. The main entrance is centered on the front, beneath one of the window columns, and has a small black door. The windows show faint reflections in blue and gray, providing a sense of transparency. The drawing includes minimal background, focusing on the structure with a plain, slightly yellowed background.
title: Corner of Pearl and John Streets
